description: The universal escape hatch. Any integration without a first-class registry entry lowers to a raw HTTP call, on every platform.

capabilities.description: Sends an HTTP request and returns the response. Used directly when no first-class capability exists, and used as the degradation target when a platform cannot express one. Authentication is carried in headers, normally from a sensitive workflow variable, because a degraded step cannot know what credential the provider wanted.

url.description: The full URL, including scheme. May contain expressions in the path or query.

headers.description: Request headers as name and value pairs. Put an API key here, referencing a sensitive variable rather than a literal.

query.description: Query string parameters as name and value pairs.

body.description: The JSON request body. Ignored for methods that do not carry one.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for a response before failing the step.
